note: Set B is better because it correctly associates the L3X3X1/4 member profile only with Module B, whereas Set A incorrectly attributes this profile to Module A as well (which lacks the label on this page). Set A also contains duplicate claims for the 3/8" Through Bolt diameter. Both sets likely misread the Module A bolt size as 5/16" (probably extracting from the dimension '3'-1 5/16"' in Module B), but Set B is otherwise more faithful.
remarks: Both sets extract '5/16"' as the bolt type for Module A, which does not appear as a standalone value in the text layer (only as part of the dimension '3'-1 5/16"') and is structurally unlikely for a main through bolt, suggesting a common extraction error.
